theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PExpr.exec_inputs_run
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PExpr.exec_inputs_run : ∀ (P : NobleFoundation.PExpr) (ins : List NobleFoundation.AOp) {zs' : List ℤ}, NobleFoundation.refRun (ins ++ P.flat) [] = some zs' → ∀ (pre t : NobleContracts.Stack), NobleContracts.Exec (NobleFoundation.lowerAll ins ++ (P.code ++ [NobleContracts.Op.word 10])) pre t ↔ t = pre ++ NobleFoundation.enc zs'

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.exec_lowerAll_from_empty
theorems.statement: @NobleFoundation.exec_lowerAll_from_empty : ∀ {ops : List NobleFoundation.AOp} {zs' : List ℤ}, NobleFoundation.refRun ops [] = some zs' → ∀ (pre t : NobleContracts.Stack), NobleContracts.Exec (NobleFoundation.lowerAll ops) pre t ↔ t = pre ++ NobleFoundation.enc zs'

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.exec_inputs_nested
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.exec_inputs_nested : ∀ (ins ops : List NobleFoundation.AOp) {zs' : List ℤ}, NobleFoundation.refRun (ins ++ ops) [] = some zs' → ∀ (pre t : NobleContracts.Stack), NobleContracts.Exec (NobleFoundation.lowerAll ins ++ [NobleContracts.Op.block (NobleFoundation.lowerAll ops), NobleContracts.Op.word 8, NobleContracts.Op.word 10, NobleContracts.Op.word 10]) pre t ↔ t = pre ++ NobleFoundation.enc zs'

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.exec_lowerAll
theorems.statement: @NobleFoundation.exec_lowerAll : ∀ {ops : List NobleFoundation.AOp} {zs zs' : List ℤ}, NobleFoundation.refRun ops zs = some zs' → ∀ (pre t : NobleContracts.Stack), NobleContracts.Exec (NobleFoundation.lowerAll ops) (pre ++ NobleFoundation.enc zs) t ↔ t = pre ++ NobleFoundation.enc zs'

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PExpr.exec_run_ref
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PExpr.exec_run_ref : ∀ (P : NobleFoundation.PExpr) {zs zs' : List ℤ}, NobleFoundation.refRun P.flat zs = some zs' → ∀ (pre t : NobleContracts.Stack), NobleContracts.Exec (P.code ++ [NobleContracts.Op.word 10]) (pre ++ NobleFoundation.enc zs) t ↔ t = pre ++ NobleFoundation.enc zs'

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.accumulate_eq_acceptLiteral
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.accumulate_eq_acceptLiteral : ∀ (negative : Bool) (ds : List (Fin 10)), NobleFoundation.accumulate negative ds = NobleFoundation.acceptLiteral negative ds
